purpose: Cross-pack asset and preset registry for spacing, typography, motion, layout references, and visual direction files used by the studio as concrete design evidence.
whenToUse: Use whenever a visual pack needs linked motion, typography, spacing, or reference files
Use when Quality or Showcase should prove the visual system comes from real repository files
Use when generation must export a traceable asset manifest alongside code output
forbiddenPatterns: describing visual direction without linking a real preset or reference file
